title: Resolve the next session stage
goal: Resolve the session's current verb stage — capability pin, adapter, and attempt identity — and return the request without executing it. Read-only: the MCP surface never passes --execute, so no attempt is created, no runner is started, and the cursor never moves.

sessionId.description: Session id whose current stage is resolved.

submissionCriteria: session exists and is not completed, failed, or aborted
the current stage is a verb stage
no gate is blocking the current stage
